status: Ratified with Wolf on 10 October 2026; design candidate returned for implementation custody, not source implementation or provider qualification.

design.acceptedUserDirection: The first message must be useful immediately. Relevant Pro context should be prominent, including connected/same-file PRs and historical file activity.
design.selectedExample: An open PR shares the two files carrying 68% of current Changed. The same files have the highest merged-PR frequencies among the five touched files. An established historical companion is unchanged here.
design.basic: Basic retains current composition and full file contributions. Optional basic repository history remains useful without the premium file-history modules.
design.limits: No mandatory Pro filler, empty Pro section, fabricated context, semantic-relatedness claim, risk score or reviewer instruction. Different observations may earn the lead on another PR.
design.held: Native GitHub rendering, actual App writer/provider behavior, selection calibration and exact control implementation remain for qualification under #476. No tracked product edits or provider launch in this design-only contribution.
design.evidence: Source, arithmetic, Markdown structure and script checks. Marked 17.0.5 plus an explicit NOTE preview approximation; the HTML is not a proof of GitHub rendering. No browser render or prepared Windows Studio engine execution is claimed.
design.acceptance: Wolf: “Yep, this is good. I like this, and we should likely go with this as ratified for now. So please make this into a durable candidate and hand all of it off.” Round 4 content, order and formatting are accepted. Numeric selection and control defaults in the handoff are Nyxara proposals, not unshown owner ratification.
design.formatting: One native top-level NOTE highlights the shared-file PR lead. Ordinary table/history, companion observation, size core and one details fold remain siblings. Links use descriptive PR titles; history frequency has typographic priority over supporting Turnover.
design.sourceSyntax: GitHub NOTE syntax with the provider-supplied fixed Note label. No custom alert title, nested alert, whole-premium wrapper, severity from tier/size, colored HTML text or decorative badges.
design.narrow: Two PR entries use paragraphs inside the alert to avoid extra list indentation. History has three columns, a numeric current-value column, and a deliberate line break between frequency and Turnover. Paths remain complete. Native table overflow still needs actual GitHub qualification.
design.acceptedHierarchy: Lead with the strongest concrete connection around this PR. Show current contribution alongside selected file history; keep a useful size/core summary in the same comment.
design.previewRole: A frozen design reference with 12 primary states. Additional availability/lifecycle specimens are in the bundle. Synthetic data and inert links; preview controls do not represent ratified App settings.

history.scope: same effective policy and path exclusions as the current comparison
